issues.description: Problem statement for Aufgabe 07 requests the names of Gemeinden and the names of the respective Freibäder, but the solution returns Gemeinde.schluessel and Schwimmbad.id (identifiers) instead of Gemeinde.name and Schwimmbad.name. This mismatch between the requested output columns and the solution's selected columns will confuse students about the expected result and grading.
issues.suggestedFix: Modify the solution (and/or template) so the query returns the requested name columns. For example: SELECT Gemeinde.name AS gemeinde_name, Schwimmbad.name AS freibad_name FROM Gemeinde JOIN Schwimmbad ON Gemeinde.schluessel = Schwimmbad.gemeindeschluessel WHERE Schwimmbad.art = 'Freibad'; This aligns the solution output with the problem description.

issues.description: The problem asks for the NAMES of Gemeinden and the NAMES of the Freibäder, but the solution returns Gemeinde.schluessel and Schwimmbad.id (identifiers) instead of the requested name columns. This mismatch between the conceptual entity 'name' in the problem statement and the actual columns returned in the solution creates confusion for students who will look for Gemeinde.name and Schwimmbad.name.
issues.suggestedFix: Return the requested name columns to match the problem description. For example: SELECT Gemeinde.name, Schwimmbad.name FROM Gemeinde, Schwimmbad WHERE Gemeinde.schluessel = Schwimmbad.gemeindeschluessel AND Schwimmbad.art = 'Freibad';
